title: Page routing ground truth
description: Per-page labels for classification, language, rotation, quality and logical-document grouping. Placed in ocr-benchmark/labels/routing/<docId>.json. Note that production classifies a whole document from page 1 only (processing_service.py calls classify(pages[0])), so page-level labels will expose misrouting inside mixed bundles that the current pipeline cannot see.

documentType.description: Registry kind where one applies (identity-card, title-certificate, form8-instrument, survey-plan, other), or a corpus-specific type such as deed, assessment-extract, court-filing.

languages.description: A page may carry more than one

correctRotation.description: Degrees clockwise needed to make the page upright

documentGroup.description: Logical document this page belongs to. Splits mixed PDFs; pages of one instrument share a group.
